faqs.q: What specific Range Rover engines do you specialize in?
faqs.a: We are specialist engineers for the full JLR range, with particular expertise in the 3.0L TDV6/SDV6, 4.4L SDV8, 5.0L V8 Supercharged, and the modern 2.0L Ingenium diesel and petrol engines.

faqs.q: Is your timing chain replacement service warrantied?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our timing chain replacements use uprated kits and come with a standard 6-month / 6,000-mile warranty, with options to extend coverage up to 24 months through our dealer-level protection plans.

faqs.q: Do you provide a full diagnostic report before starting any repair?
faqs.a: Yes, every vehicle undergoes a comprehensive JLR-certified diagnostic health check. We provide a detailed technical report and a fixed-price quote before any mechanical work begins.

faqs.q: Can you handle ECU programming and coding after an engine swap?
faqs.a: Yes, we utilize the latest JLR Pathfinder and TOPIx software to perform all necessary module programming, adaptations, and coding to ensure the new engine is perfectly integrated with your vehicle's systems.

faqs.q: Do you offer nationwide collection for all engine services?
faqs.a: We offer secure nationwide collection and delivery for all major engine services, including rebuilds, replacements, and significant mechanical repairs, ensuring your vehicle is handled by experts from start to finish.
